interpretation: Beam reference omits shear deformation and local load introduction; close agreement is a sanity check, not full validation.
formulation: 2D plane stress, 4-node isoparametric quadrilaterals, 2x2 Gauss integration, constant thickness, homogeneous isotropic E and nu
display: Displacements use the solved nodal fields with the stated 200x exaggeration. Density replay colors describe density, not stress. Final polished solid is rho=0.5 contour reconstruction and has not been separately strength-certified.
